character.name: Branok Morvain
character.background: Paladin / Disgraced Noble, falsely accused of treason, stripped of title and divine favor

spells.name: Wrathful Smite
spells.description: The next creature you hit with a weapon attack must make a DC 11 Wisdom save or take 1d6 psychic damage and be frightened of you until the spell ends. The taint of your broken oath twists the divine magic into a vision of their deepest regrets. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of it

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: A creature of your choice within 60 ft gains +2 AC for 1 minute. The magic is faintly tainted, leaving a cold shimmer around the target.

traits: Unwavering Honesty: Cannot tell a lie, even when it would spare him pain or danger, a quirk that has earned him more enemies than allies on the run.
Guilt-Ridden: Carries the weight of the men who died at the border fort due to the traitor's plot, and refuses all offers of help, believing he deserves his suffering.
Oathbound Still: Despite deliberately breaking his divine oath, he still adheres to the knightly code of protecting the weak, though he refuses to call it piety.
Fears His Tainted Power: The magic he wields is twisted by his broken oath, and he worries one day he will lose control and become the monster the Order claims he is.
character.gear: Dented ancestral longsword · Dented chain mail · Raven-marked shield · Healing potion · Tattered oathstone amulet · 3 days of iron rations · Flint and steel · Dark grey travel cloak
character.story: Branok Morvain, youngest captain of the Order of the Silver Shield, was framed for treason by Lord Varen after a border fort he commanded was overrun. Stripped of his oath, title, and sentenced to death, he fled into the frozen borderlands, hunted by the Order he once led. He did not fail his oath — he broke it deliberately to stop Varen's plot to seize his family's lands and massacre a nearby village. The cracked oathstone in his pocket burns with tainted magic, a constant reminder of the guilt he carries. Now he walks the line between redemption and ruin, seeking to restore his name or avenge the lives lost to Varen's treachery.

inventory.name: Dented ancestral longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for House Morvain three centuries prior, this blade bore the family raven crest until half was scoured off during Branok's trial. It was seized by the Order when he was condemned, but he reclaimed it the night he escaped the capital.
inventory.description: A dented steel longsword with a cracked leather grip, dried blood staining the fuller. It has not been properly cleaned since Branok's escape.

inventory.name: Dented chain mail
inventory.lore: Standard issue armor of the Order of the Silver Shield, dented during the battle where Branok was framed for abandoning his post. He wore it hidden under a travel cloak when he fled, and the dents remain as a reminder of his failure to protect his men.
inventory.description: A suit of interlocking steel rings, dented in three places from axe blows and crossbow bolts. The Silver Shield sigil on the chest has been half-scratched off.

inventory.name: Raven-marked shield
inventory.lore: Once bore the raven crest of House Morvain, now faded to a dull grey. A deep gouge from Lord Varen's personal axe marks the face, left the night Branok was framed.
inventory.description: A heavy wooden shield reinforced with iron bands, the raven crest faded but still visible. The gouge from Varen's axe glints when the light hits it just right.

inventory.name: Healing potion
inventory.lore: Stolen from the Order's infirmary the night Branok escaped. The divine magic within is tainted by his broken oath, leaving a faint taste of ash when consumed.
inventory.description: A small glass vial of deep red liquid, warm to the touch, with a faint smell of ozone and burnt rosemary.
inventory.effects: Restores 2d4+2 hit points when drunk. The tainted magic leaves a faint, cold burn in the drinker's chest for an hour after consumption.

inventory.name: Tattered oathstone amulet
inventory.lore: The amulet all Silver Shield paladins wear, inscribed with their personal oath. Branok's is cracked down the middle, the divine magic fizzling out, but it pulses faintly with cold light when he is near those who betrayed him.
inventory.description: A cracked grey stone on a frayed leather cord, the oath inscription half-erased. It is ice cold to the touch unless near traitors, when it burns like frozen iron.
inventory.effects: When activated, the user can cast Detect Evil and Good. Using the stone deals 1d4 necrotic damage to the user, as the tainted magic bites back.

inventory.name: 3 days of iron rations
inventory.lore: Stolen from a merchant's wagon the first night after Branok's escape. The bland hard tack and dried venison have kept him alive through the harsh borderland winters.
inventory.description: Three small cloth-wrapped parcels of hard tack and dried venison, bound with twine.

inventory.name: Flint and steel
inventory.lore: Taken from a dead border guard after a skirmish on the night of Branok's escape. It has started hundreds of fires, keeping him warm through freezing nights on the run.
inventory.description: A piece of flint wrapped in oiled leather, and a small steel striker, both worn smooth from use.

inventory.name: Dark grey travel cloak
inventory.lore: Dyed the traditional grey of House Morvain, it has a hidden inner pocket where Branok hides his oathstone to avoid the cold pulse giving him away to pursuers.
inventory.description: A heavy, frayed wool cloak with a deep hood, stained with mud and dried blood from Branok's journey across the border.
